senses.gloss:
ITA-1.7.8 arthaprāptiḥ अर्थप्राप्तिः
Implied meaning
A statement whose derived meaning allows for another interpretation.

ITA-1.7.9 arthāntaram अर्थान्तरम्
Varying meaning or shifting the topic
A statement that is not relevant or applicable to its context.

ITA-1.6.10 arthāpattiḥ अर्थापत्तिः
Implied or inferred meaning
Making statements in such a way to allow room for different inferences or presumptions.

ITA-1.6.37 arthāśrayaḥ अर्थाश्रयः
Source of meaning
The word or part of a sentence which encapsulates the actual meaning.
